definitions.explanation: A fictitious name adopted by a writer, borrowed from the English term 'pen name.'

examples.japanese: ペンネームで{投稿|とうこう}する。
examples.english: To submit a piece under a pen name.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}はペンネームで{小説|しょうせつ}を{書|か}いている。
examples.english: She writes novels under a pen name.

examples.japanese: ペンネームを{決|き}めるのに{時間|じかん}がかかったが、{気|き}に{入|い}った{名前|なまえ}が{見|み}つかった。
examples.english: It took time to decide on a pen name, but I found a name I liked.

notes:
From English "pen name." More commonly used in modern Japanese than the native equivalent {筆名|ひつめい}, especially among younger writers and in casual contexts. While {筆名|ひつめい} has a more literary and formal feel, ペンネーム is the everyday choice.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ペンネームを{使|つか}う: to use a pen name
- ペンネームで{活動|かつどう}する: to be active under a pen name
- ペンネームを{決|き}める: to decide on a pen name
- ペンネームで{発表|はっぴょう}する: to publish under a pen name

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {筆名|ひつめい}: pen name — the Sino-Japanese equivalent, more formal and literary
- ハンドルネーム: handle name; screen name — used for online identities
- {芸名|げいめい}: stage name — used by performers and entertainers
